design.close_quote: last quote at or before kickoff-15m
design.population: moneyline: YES contract of each team (NO side is the other team's YES); spread: YES and NO of every ticker with candles+tape; preseason excluded

queue_assumptions.THROUGH_ONLY: only prints strictly through the limit

design.tape_cap: newest 10,000 prints per ticker; orders whose window starts before the oldest retained print are UNCERTAIN and excluded

variants.V0: rest to kickoff, unfilled = 0 (order simply not executed)
variants.V1: rest until T-90m, then cancel and TAKE the remainder at the T-90m ask

discovery_calibration.note: p_cal = mid + beta*(model-mid); beta fitted on discovery only (OLS through origin, clipped to [0,1])

integration.reading: Per-contract net P&L in cents after modelled fees; 95% CI by game cluster. The framework is judged on whether it avoids the loss of unconditional buying and on any positive net EV of the actions it does take; a PASS-heavy result with mean ~0 means no validated edge was found, not that the framework made money. Nothing here is a promotion decision.

4_net_returns_after_fees.note: every EV is net of the Kalshi general-schedule fee (taker 0.07 / maker 0.0175 MODELLED) per cent per contract; see sections 2-3 for cells

cfb.null_statement: no cell survived BH<=0.10 on discovery; holdout evaluated only for frozen cells; 3 weeks of data is a short sample
